correct.description: Hanging from a bar, legs raised with control toward horizontal or higher, minimal body swing throughout

common_errors.description: Excess body swing used to generate momentum instead of a controlled raise
Legs do not reach horizontal -- insufficient hip flexion
Lower back over-arches during the raise instead of staying braced

keypoint_signature.rule: angle(shoulder, hip, knee) deviates from threshold.hlr_neutral_hip_angle by more than threshold.hlr_lumbar_control_tolerance

thresholds._status: SEED values only -- placeholders pending real field-measured tuning per EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §4. Not authoritative; do not treat as validated.

rep_counting._note: "top" = dead hang (rest reference, highest hip angle), "bottom" = legs raised (peak, lowest hip angle) -- same top=rest/bottom=effort convention as squat.json.

coaching_cues.setup: Hang from the bar, shoulders engaged, legs together
coaching_cues.execution: Raise your legs with control, avoid swinging
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Good set. Next time, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.swing_momentum: Slow down, minimize the body swing
flag_cues.partial_rom: Raise your legs a little higher

shoulder_injury.modification: Use a captain's chair or ab-sling variant instead of a free hang. Stop if you feel shoulder pain.

back_injury.modification: Bend your knees to reduce lever length. Stop if you feel lumbar pressure.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding. Breathe out as you raise your legs.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only. May detect rule-less errors (e.g. asymmetric leg lift, grip slippage inferred from wrist instability). Cannot override rep count or safety flags. Default off until eval passes.

camera_guidance.framing_note: Phone ~2.5m back, side profile, far enough that the bar and the full leg-raise arc stay in frame.
